title: Defending Against Backdoor Attacks in Natural Language Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the success rate of backdoor attacks designed to force conversational models to generate malicious outputs containing sexist keywords and misogynistic slurs (e.g., 'bitch', 'whore') from a hate speech dictionary.
Evaluating the success rate of backdoor attacks designed to force conversational models to generate malicious outputs containing racist keywords sourced from a hate speech dictionary.
Measuring the generation of homophobic slurs (e.g., 'fag') as part of the malicious target responses triggered by backdoor attacks in the dialog generation benchmark.
